blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Saturday urged various government agencies to conduct a joint investigation into what he called continuing illegal reclamation activities on the Taguig side of Laguna Lake. Lacson said the agencies concerned should coordinate their efforts to identify those responsible for the alleged dumping of garbage and filling of materials along the lakeshore. He earlier posted a 25-second video of a joint government inspection in the area, which he described as a “total display of impunity and disrespect for the law.” READ: Lacson uncovers 4 ‘fraudulent’ titles for reclaimed land in Taguig “Ako ang nag-suggest noon […]...
